column1: SUPERSEDED — this artifact is retired. Do not read it, do not regenerate it.
Superseded by:  OBLIGATIONS.tsv  (verdict is DERIVED, not stored)
Last content:   da61fa5b — recover with
git show da61fa5b:docs/migration/evidence/corpus/VERDICTS.tsv
WHY, and it is not that the column was wrong.
It went stale, and a human noticed rather than a gate. We did not repair that
staleness — we removed the POSSIBILITY of it, by deriving the verdict from the
obligations that justify it. A stored verdict column beside a derived one is
exactly the shape that went stale, so keeping this file alive would reintroduce
the possibility together with a checker to manage it. A check that exists only
to police a redundancy is a reason to delete the redundancy.
HOW TO GET WHAT THIS FILE USED TO GIVE YOU.
verdict is a FUNCTION of OBLIGATIONS.tsv, and EXPECTED-MATCH is the COMPLEMENT
of the carrying set — so it needs a denominator, which lives in INVOCATIONS.tsv:
universe        = INVOCATIONS.tsv rows whose `phase` column EQUALS "P1"  (1065)
join key        = (dirname(case), consumer)   # INVOCATIONS keys on the
# consumers.tsv PATH,
# OBLIGATIONS on the case DIR
DIVERGENCE      = keys present in OBLIGATIONS.tsv                        (581)
MATCH           = universe minus those keys                              (484)
Match `phase` EXACTLY. "P1" as a SUBSTRING also admits P1-ADJACENT and inflates
the universe to 1414 — measured, in a hand-written probe, with correct arithmetic
on top of it. verify-obligations.py asserts this population and is red-proved by
a mutation a substring matcher structurally cannot fail.
Its generator (verdicts.py) and gate (verify-verdicts.py) are retired in the same
commit; both are recoverable from da61fa5b.
